comment: Which file inside a mod folder both sides hash to identify it. The indexer reads archive entries, modrex-main reads the installed directory, and a disagreement makes that mod permanently unidentifiable, so the vectors live here once and both sides test against them. Paths are relative to the mod's own root; the indexer strips a single wrapper directory before comparing. Read by apps/index/test-marker-contract.ts and by modrex-main's marker_contract_tests.rs.
rule: A marker file at the mod root wins: main.xml, then supermod.xml, then mod.xml (the indexer also recognises mod.txt and base.lua ahead of those, which the games writing them always ship). Otherwise take the path whose UTF-8 bytes sort first, skipping files the OS regenerates. Never locale-aware comparison, never directory-walk order.

cases.name: a dot sorts before an underscore by bytes, and after it under ICU collation
a file sorts before a directory sharing its stem
digits compare as characters, not as numbers

uppercase sorts before lowercase, and no case folding is applied. Two paths differing only in case are deliberately not a vector: Windows collapses them to one installed file, so the two sides can never see the same set
a nested path can win outright
non-ascii compares by its utf-8 bytes
a marker at the mod root beats any sort order
a marker below the mod root is not a marker
a single file is the pick whatever it is called
files the OS regenerates are never the pick, however early they sort
a folder holding nothing but OS files has no representative file
